Dehydrated Fenugreek Seeds Supplier: Whole Fenugreek Seeds for B2B Food Manufacturing

Whole fenugreek seeds, known in India as methi dana, are a staple spice for curry blends, pickles, seasonings and spice mills around the world. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated fenugreek seeds supplier from India, serving food manufacturers, spice blenders, importers, wholesalers and private label brands. We supply clean, food-grade whole seeds that are dried to a stable moisture level and ready for roasting, tempering, grinding or blending. Buyers who need cracked or milled fenugreek can discuss this with us when they request a quote. Fenugreek seeds have a warm, bitter and aromatic taste with a light maple-like note. They add depth to spice blends and are used across Indian, Middle Eastern, African and North African cooking. That is why they appear in so many commercial seasoning formulas. Tradenest Naturals supplies consistent lots with practical packaging, batch traceability and export documentation support.

Product Overview

Dehydrated fenugreek seeds are the dried seeds of the fenugreek plant, Trigonella foenum-graecum. The standard product has no added preservatives, colours or artificial flavours. Seeds are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, then processed under controlled conditions. Our standard supply is clean, dry and aromatic whole methi dana. Whole seeds suit buyers who grind, roast or extract in their own plants, and they hold their aroma well in storage. If your process calls for a cracked or milled form, we can review it during quotation. The final form and specification are confirmed in writing before production.

Processing Method

Raw seeds are carefully selected from trusted growers. We inspect each incoming lot for appearance, cleanliness and suitability. The seeds are then cleaned to remove dust, stones, stalks and other foreign matter. After cleaning, the seeds are dried under controlled conditions to bring moisture down to the agreed level. This supports stable storage and helps keep the natural aroma. The seeds are then graded and sieved to give an even, clean lot. Finally, each approved batch is packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging.
  • Raw material selection and receiving inspection
  • Cleaning and foreign-matter removal
  • Controlled drying and moisture management
  • Grading and sieving of whole seeds
  • Batch identification and packing inspection
Processing settings can vary with seed condition, order size and end use. We confirm the agreed specification before production starts. This gives buyers a practical and repeatable ingredient from one order to the next.

Typical Technical Specifications

Our standard specification is clean whole seeds with low moisture, a bright natural colour and typical fenugreek aroma. Moisture is held at 8% or less. Shelf life is 12 months in sealed packs stored as recommended.
  • Form: Dehydrated whole seeds
  • Mesh: Whole seeds (not milled)
  • Moisture: ≤ 8%
  • Purity: Cleaned and graded, with foreign matter controlled to the agreed specification
  • Color: Natural yellow to yellow-brown
  • Flavor: Warm, bitter, earthy and slightly maple-like
These are standard commercial values and are confirmed in the buyer-approved specification. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Quality and Food Safety Approach

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business. We follow documented food-safety practices, standard operating procedures, moisture control, batch traceability and quality inspection. Customer requirements are reviewed before production, and we share batch and product information for each order. We only state what we can support for the product and shipment. If your market needs specific documents, such as an allergen statement, a particular test or import paperwork, please list them in your enquiry. We will confirm what we can provide. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Our in-house checks cover appearance, odour, moisture, foreign matter and other agreed parameters. For export orders, we also review packaging, labelling and documentation. This gives buyers a clear supply plan before dispatch.

Applications

Whole fenugreek seeds are a working ingredient in many dry blends and cooked products. They give a warm, distinctive spice note that is hard to replace.
  • Curries, gravies, pickles and traditional spice preparations
  • Curry powder, garam masala, chaat masala and seasoning blends
  • Bakery products, savoury snacks, crackers and namkeen
  • Ready-to-cook meals, instant mixes and soups
  • Chutney powders, herbal blends and specialty foods
  • Traditional Ayurvedic and herbal formulations, subject to the buyer's regulatory review
Whole seeds suit tempering, roasting, sprouting, extraction and in-house grinding. Grinding close to the point of use also helps keep aroma fresh. Our team can help you match the seed lot to your process.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We use food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging built for storage and transport. Standard options include 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg packs. Bulk bags and custom export packaging are also available for larger programmes. Packaging can include inner liners, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers or private label formats. Each pack can carry the product name, net weight, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage guidance and required regulatory details. Export labels follow your approved artwork and destination requirements. Shelf life is 12 months from manufacture when the product is sealed and stored correctly. Store in a cool, dry, clean area. Protect from direct sunlight, high humidity, heat and strong odours.

MOQ, Samples, and Lead Time

The minimum order quantity is 5 Kg. This makes it easy to run trials or start with a small first shipment. Private label and custom packaging orders are quoted based on pack size and artwork. Lead time depends on raw material availability, quantity, packaging and destination documentation. We confirm the production and dispatch schedule in the quotation. Printed packaging or custom requirements may need extra time. To request a sample or quote, send the form, quantity, packaging format, destination country and end use. Please also share any labelling or documentation requirements. Our team will review your request and send a clear commercial offer.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

  • Consistent supply from an India-based food ingredient exporter
  • Clean, graded whole seeds with a clear agreed specification
  • Support for bulk, wholesale, OEM and private label programmes
  • Moisture-resistant packaging for domestic and export shipments
  • Clear communication on MOQ, documentation and lead time
  • Practical help with application and packing questions
Tradenest Naturals serves buyers looking for a dependable dehydrated fenugreek seeds exporter and bulk methi dana supplier. We work with wholesalers, importers, food brands and manufacturers on both trial and regular volumes. Our focus is steady specifications, clear service and long-term business relationships.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

The MOQ is 5 Kg. We confirm final terms after reviewing packaging and any customisation.

What specifications are available?

The standard product is dehydrated whole seeds with moisture of 8% or less and a 12 month shelf life. Final specifications are agreed with the buyer.

What certifications apply?

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What packaging and shelf life are offered?

We offer food-grade packs from 1 kg up to bulk bags. Shelf life is 12 months under recommended storage conditions.

How can I request a sample or quotation?

Send your quantity, destination, product form, packaging and any quality requirements. We will review the request and reply with supply details.
